C1340.title: NIST Round 4 Candidate Post-Quantum Algorithm SIKE Broken
C1340.summary: In August 2022, researchers from KU Leuven published a paper demonstrating a practical break of SIKEp434, a Round 4 candidate in the NIST post-quantum cryptography standardization process, using a single-core processor in 62 minutes. Higher security levels SIKEp503, p610, and p751 were also broken within hours. The attack recovers the private key, effectively compromising the supersingular isogeny
